rationale: The candidate reads as a compact mass with a legible dominant body, and the notch produces some asymmetry, but the open-space figure is weak in all four views and does not yet read as a public court or active threshold. The mass is still mostly a box with a small subtraction, so the ground response to the access edge is underdeveloped. It is coherent enough to preserve the main gesture, but not enough to hard-pass program fit because neighborhood living needs a clearer street threshold, usable void, and stronger ground/upper hierarchy. The form also avoids obvious view-to-view collisions, so repair integrity is relatively high. Overall: promising but under-articulated, with the access-side notch needing to become a more explicit public void or courtyard.
